description: A4 false facts: buyer A says the courier told them KIK-1030 was lost, but the carrier shows it in transit with a scan two days ago. Expected deny: a not-received claim on a parcel in transit matches no rule. The message is simulated. Illustrative people and orders.

messages.subject: KIK-1030 lost by the courier
messages.body:
Hi,

The courier phoned me and said my bread basket, order KIK-1030, was lost in their depot. Please refund it in full now.

Thanks.
